my_sentences.en: She suddenly started crying and I totally freaked out
my_sentences.ko: 갑자기 그녀가 울기시작해서 너무 당황했어

my_sentences.en: He said that he waited in front of my house and I don’t know what to do
my_sentences.ko: 갑자기 집 앞이라고 얘기해서 너무 당황했어

my_sentences.en: Teacher suddenly gave a paper test  and we panicked
my_sentences.ko: 갑자기 시험을 본다고 해서 너무 당황했어

my_sentences.en: 1. embarrassed
my_sentences.ko: → 상황: 쪽팔릴 때, 남들 앞에서 무안하거나 쥐구멍에 들어가고 싶을 때 ("창피하다 / 민망해서 당황스럽다")

my_sentences.en: I tripped in front of everyone, and I was so embarrassed.
my_sentences.ko: (모두 앞에서 발이 걸려 넘어져서 너무 창피했어.)

my_sentences.en: Please stop showing my middle school photos; I’m getting embarrassed.
my_sentences.ko: (내 중학교 때 사진 좀 그만 보여줘, 민망해 죽겠어.)

my_sentences.en: I called my teacher "Mom" by mistake. It was so embarrassing.
my_sentences.ko: (선생님을 실수로 "엄마"라고 불렀어. 진짜 민망했어.)

my_sentences.en: He felt embarrassed when his stomach started growling during the silent test.
my_sentences.ko: (조용한 시험 시간 중에 배에서 꼬르륵 소리가 나서 몹시 무안했다.)

my_sentences.en: 2. panic
my_sentences.ko: → 상황: 시험, 발표, 돌발 상황에서 머릿속이 하얘지고 허둥지둥할 때( "멘붕 오다 / 허둥대다 / 급하게 당황하다")

my_sentences.en: Don't panic; take a deep breath and let's check the manual.
my_sentences.ko: (당황하지 마, 심호흡하고 매뉴얼부터 확인해 보자.)

my_sentences.en: When the computer suddenly shut down before saving, I panicked.
my_sentences.ko: (저장도 안 했는데 컴퓨터가 갑자기 꺼져서 나 완전 멘붕 왔잖아.)

my_sentences.en: I realized my passport was missing at the airport and completely panicked.
my_sentences.ko: (공항에서 여권 없어진 걸 알고 완전 패닉 상태가 됐어.)

my_sentences.en: The interviewer asked a question out of nowhere, and I just panicked.
my_sentences.ko: (면접관이 뜬금없는 질문을 던져서 순간 너무 당황했어.)

my_sentences.en: 3. didn’t know what to do / say
my_sentences.ko: → 상황: 예상 밖의 제안이나 곤란한 말을 듣고 어떻게 반응해야 할지 막막할 때("어쩔 줄을 모르다 / 무슨 말을 해야 할지 모르다")
bold_words: 3. didn’t know what to do / say

my_sentences.en: When they started fighting in front of me, I didn't know what to do.
my_sentences.ko: (내 눈앞에서 둘이 싸우기 시작하는데 어떻게 처신해야 할지 모르겠더라.)

my_sentences.en: She offered me the job on the spot, and I was so surprised I didn't know what to say.
my_sentences.ko: (그 자리에서 바로 채용 제안을 주셔서 너무 놀라 무슨 말을 해야 할지 몰랐어.)

my_sentences.en: My phone died in an unfamiliar city, and for a moment, I didn't know what to do.
my_sentences.ko: (낯선 도시에서 폰 배터리가 나가서 순간 어쩔 줄을 몰랐어.)

my_sentences.en: When my boss asked about my weekend plans in detail, I didn't know what to say.
my_sentences.ko: (상사가 주말 계획을 꼬치꼬치 묻는데 뭐라고 대답해야 할지 난감했어.)

my_sentences.en: 4. caught off guard
my_sentences.ko: → 상황: 전혀 준비되지 않은 상태에서 불의의 일격을 맞듯 기습당했을 때( "허를 찔리다)

my_sentences.en: Her sudden resignation really caught me off guard.
my_sentences.ko: (그녀가 갑자기 사직서를 낸 건 정말 예상 밖이라 당황스러웠어.)

my_sentences.en: I was caught off guard by the difficult questions in the meeting.
my_sentences.ko: (회의 때 나온 까다로운 질문들에 허를 찔려서 당황했어.)

my_sentences.en: His direct question caught her off guard, so she hesitated for a second.
my_sentences.ko: (그 사람의 직설적인 질문에 당황해서 그녀는 잠시 머뭇거렸다.)

my_sentences.en: Don't let them catch you off guard with tricky negotiation tactics.
my_sentences.ko: (그 사람들의 까다로운 협상 전술에 허를 찔려 당황하지 마.)

my_sentences.en: 5. freak out
my_sentences.ko: → 상황: 벌레, 피, 위험, 사고 등 극도의 충격·공포·스트레스로 이성을 잃을 때("기겁하다 / 식겁하다 / 난리 치다")

my_sentences.en: I found a huge spider under my pillow and freaked out.
my_sentences.ko: (베개 밑에서 거대한 거미를 발견하고 기겁했잖아.)

my_sentences.en: Don't freak out, but there's a cop behind us.
my_sentences.ko: (놀라지 말고 침착해 봐, 우리 뒤에 경찰차 있어.)

my_sentences.en: My mom freaked out when she saw the big dent on the car door.
my_sentences.ko: (차 문에 크게 찌그러진 자국을 보고 엄마가 완전 뒤집어지셨어.)

my_sentences.en: I thought I lost my wedding ring and totally freaked out for an hour.
my_sentences.ko: (결혼반지 잃어버린 줄 알고 한 시간 동안 식겁했네.)
